usedFor: flowyteam flags key results and viaSocket utilities runs the follow-up workflow when “New Off-Track Key Result” calls “Flow in Flow”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A key result going off track starts your own follow-up workflow, such as alerting the owner.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” requires the child workflow's flow ID and payload method, so set both first.
